description: Reserved matters application for the approval of Conditions 4 (reserved matters for the Outline elements) and 6 (details of the layout, scale, appearance and landscaping)  - Phase 2 of development up to 762 dwellings (C3) - of hybrid planning permission 00676/88/P2 dated 08/07/2016 for demolition of existing building, to include a full application for 178 residential dwellings (C3 use), flexible uses including retail (A1 use) or cafe (A3 use) or community centre (D1 use), car parking, public space, landscaping and associated works and an Outline application for 762 residential dwellings (C3 use) associated car parking, public spaces landscaping and associated works with all matters to be reserve except means of access.
decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - Prior to first occupation of each block full details (including manufacturers specifications, mix of stand types, and entrances) of secure covered cycle parking facilities, in accordance with relevant planning policy, for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved facilities shall fully implemented and be made available for use before the first occupation of the development and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved drawings full details of the proposed car park accesses, to be designed as raised crossovers, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of construction of each Block or the adjoining street. No part of the relevant Block shall be occupied until the new means of access has been sited, laid out and constructed in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 4 - Prior to first occupation of each relevant Block hereby permitted full details of pedestrian visibility splays of 2.4m x 2.4m to be provided on each side of the car park access to guide pedestrians away from the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 600mm in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected or allowed to grow within the areas of these splays on land within the approved development site.

Condition : 5 - The development shall not be occupied until arrangements have been agreed in writing with the local planning authority and put in place to ensure that, with the exception of disabled persons, no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit in surrounding CPZ's controlled by the Council and any controlled parking zone controlled by the Council which may be in force in the area at any time.
